        self, features: torch.Tensor, items: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        # DEBUG: no traceback was supplied, so the original failure is unknown.
        # Fix a concrete broadcasting defect: B x L x D features with B x K
        # candidates previously failed, or silently paired unrelated axes when
        # L == K. Preserve paired scoring and existing training/diagnostic calls.

        # One item per feature, including B x L masked-position labels.

        # B x K candidates broadcast over all L positions of B x L x D.

            len(candidate_prefix) > len(feature_shape)
